eligibility: validation PASS on both development intervals
positive cost-after total return on both development intervals
completed independent trades at least the calendar-day count on each interval
selection_rule: Among eligible candidates, maximize the lower of the two cost-after daily geometric growth rates. If tied, maximize the product of the two interval NAV growth factors. If no candidate is eligible, do not inspect the reserved holdout and redesign the policy.
note: This contract was committed while the development ablation was still running and before any router result was viewed.
